name: robyn-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Robyn, an async Python web framework whose HTTP server runtime is
written in Rust (the compiled `robyn.robyn` extension) while routing, handler parameter injection,
response formatting, middlewares, authentication, sessions, dependency injection, OpenAPI generation,
templating, the in-process test client, the command-line configuration and the MCP server layer are
implemented in Python.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the robyn Python package, that is every module directly in robyn/ except robyn/ai.py (the robyn/scaffold/ project templates and the compiled robyn.robyn extension are not part of it), together with README.md, the page docs_src/src/pages/documentation/en/plugins.mdx and these pages in docs_src/src/pages/documentation/en/api_reference/: index.mdx, getting_started.mdx, advanced_routing.mdx, request_object.mdx, response-objects.mdx, middlewares.mdx, authentication.mdx, sessions.mdx, dependency_injection.mdx, exceptions.mdx, redirection.mdx, cors.mdx, form_data.mdx, file-uploads.mdx, static-files.mdx, templating.mdx, openapi.mdx, pydantic.mdx, testing.mdx, server_sent_events.mdx, websockets.mdx, robyn_env.mdx, cheatsheet.mdx, const_requests.mdx, advanced_features.mdx, timeout_configuration.mdx, multiprocess_execution.mdx and mcps.mdx, and the module, class and function docstrings of the package.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the doc
